title: 第2章 是他吗？
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 徐喜弟哼了一声。她不伺候了！没等范金花老两口过来，她甩手就进屋，也不管滚在地上的人，回到房里一屁股坐在床上。她得走！得离开这个家！她吃喝拉撒伺候了张永福六年，也忍了六年他阴晴不定的怪脾气。现在她不忍了，爱咋咋地吧！徐喜弟刚坐下，范金花就跟着冲进来。“喜弟，你做什么把阿福摔地上？滚一身的水，他可是你丈夫。”徐喜弟没有回话，抱着手把头脸别到一边。范金花心里也知道，她肯定是觉得委屈了，才对永福撒气。“阿福的身子越来越差，他生来就没做过正常人，脾气是差了点，可眼下也没剩几天日子……”“做人，不能这么忘恩负义……”话只说到这，范金花就哽咽着转身出去了。忘恩负义？这一家子真懂怎么拿捏她！徐喜弟得了这样的话，心里堵得慌，起身出了房门，饭也不吃就背着筐出门。不管怎么样，圈里的猪今天还得喂。今年要想办法多喂一头猪，卖钱攒起来。经过昨夜，她想过了。张家要孩子是吧？那就生！生完她就走！彻底摆脱这个家！……徐喜弟气呼呼走到村头，正好看到堂叔刘烨挑着两大捆草进村，这是用来喂牛的。“喜弟，去割猪菜吗？”即使挑着比别人大两三倍的牛草，刘烨语气依旧松快，脸上也有汗，却不像是累出来的。按他的实力，一边手抱一百斤石头，还能健步如飞，这捆牛草肯定没有百斤，所以扁担在他厚实的肩膀上跳跃，像是自己蹦回来的。“呃……叔，你都已经干一节活回来了，挺早。”徐喜弟跟往常一样回应他的招呼。“今天不算早。”刘烨笑着又应了一句。两人擦过后，徐喜弟背着竹筐，一直走了很远，才敢回头看。刘烨已经挑着猪草进村了。刘烨，村里的超级困难户，因为年纪大，徐喜弟管他叫叔。三十五岁了还没娶上媳妇。原因很简单，孤儿，家穷，人又傻憨，还吃得多，一顿饭至少要吃五碗。几年前村大队分了地，一人分一亩水田，两亩旱地，种出来粮食，除去交公粮，剩下的都不够他一个人吃。但好在他力气大，人也勤快，自己那点田地轻松几天就能打理得明明白白。剩下的空余时间，村里谁家忙不过来就叫他，也不给工钱，干一天活管两顿饭，午饭和晚饭。他也干得热火朝天。张国海家，就没少找他。每年农忙的时候，犁田秋收，他第一时间先把张国海家的做完，然后才做自家的。最后才忙村里其他人的。总之谁都爱叫他，尤其去年村里一批年轻人去了深市，好些家里劳动力少了，更少不得找他帮忙。徐喜弟看着飞快远去的背影，昨晚的人会不会是他？力气那么大，拽她跟拎小鸡仔似的。她实在想不出除了他以外更适合的人，他傻憨，听话，嘴还严，最靠谱。说不定，以后还能让他做免费劳动力，一起养孩子…………徐喜弟不在家，张国海和范金花又开始坐在火房，叽叽咕咕商量起来。张国海一脸气愤，“她想干嘛？就那样把阿福摔地上，忘恩负义的白眼狼！她心里压根就不把自己丈夫当人，你还敢指望她生了孩子后乖乖听话？”范金花也是这么想的，但她这个时候不能火上浇油，得解决问题。“我看是阿福早上闹，才把她惹火了。等生孩子，她当了妈，就知道该怎么好好过日子了。”张国海却不能认同，“那可难说，她爹妈还不是随随便便就把她扔外边，那样的人家，出来的孩子，八九不离十都狠心又绝情。”“前几天，我看到她和赵家那口子说话，一个劲问赵彩艳去深市的事，她是不是想背着我们，偷偷跑出去？”“什么？”范金花一听这个，大惊失色，“她打听赵彩艳做什么？”“不行，咱们得让她和阿福把结婚证领了。这样她这辈子就拴咱们家了。”“领了证，她就是跑出去也不能嫁人，又有孩子在这，她肯定还要顾及骨肉亲情。”“现在新政策不一样了，没到年龄呢，领不了！怪你太着急，生孩子这事应该再推两年，哄哄两年把证领了，再想要孩子的事。”张国海鼻子哼哼，责怪老婆子太心急。“我能不着急吗？我都找人算过了，咱们阿福，只怕活不过明年，等不到和她领证。”范金花说到这，就两眼泪花。“要是阿福一死，咱们用什么名义让她给咱家生孩子？村里人又会怎么说？唾沫都能把人淹死！”说着她就抹起眼泪，“阿福还在，咱们让她要个孩子，名正言顺。否则，还真是白白给人养女儿养媳妇……”范金花一边说，一边朝对面的张国海的腰间瞥了一眼，“咱们张家到了这一代，眼看就要绝后了，得怪你……”“我的姐妹嫁出去，都能生三个四个。咱们家就两个，一个哑巴，一个下不了地……”她的意思很明白，张国海这个鬼德行，种不好，生出来的孩子都糟心。而且生完儿子后，她就开始守活寡。他不仅那事不行，连一点重活都干不动，分了地后家里全靠刘烨帮衬。张国海脸一黑，也抱着手，别过头又是一声冷哼，“那你找的人，算的靠谱不靠谱？确定一次就能得个儿子？”“那人说了，连续三天机会更大，要是想保险一点，得连续七天。”范金花把那天在集市上算的事一五一十全说了。“什么？还得七天才保险？”张国海瞪大了双眼，“那个人是骗子吧？生个孩子有那么复杂吗？”瞪完又有点心虚。范金花翻了他一个白眼，“七天也叫复杂？一个好生，一个身强体壮，保准七天就能怀上。”张国海心口有些堵得慌，昨晚他们听动静一直听到深夜，已经够憋屈的，还要连听七天？不怪阿福发脾气，他都想发脾气了。事关男人的尊严，换谁心里又好受？“你跟人说了吗？七天。”张国海闷闷开口。“我这不是先跟你商量吗。”“之前商量，你又不提七天的事，现在才说！”“我那不是怕你们不同意，现在事已经开始办了，谁也别回头。这两天，我给喜弟炖点肉补补，包成的。”范金花已经做好了打算，那人说了，这几天进补连续办事，不成事包退钱。
content_en: Xu Xidi snorted.She doesn't want to serve anymore!Before Fan Jinhua and his wife came over, she waved her hands and walked into the room. She didn't care about the people rolling on the floor, returned to the room and sat down on the bed.She has to go!Gotta leave this house!She had served Zhang Yongfu for six years, eating, drinking, and having sex, and she had also endured his unpredictable temper for six years.Now she can't bear it any more, so let's do whatever it takes!As soon as Xu Xidi sat down, Fan Jinhua rushed in."Xidi, what did you do to throw Ah Fu to the ground? He's covered in water. He's your husband." Xu Xidi didn't reply. He held his hands and turned his head and face away.Fan Jinhua also knew in her heart that she must have felt wronged and vented her anger on Yongfu."Afu's health is getting worse and worse. He has never been a normal person since he was born. His temper is a bit bad, but there are only a few days left..." "As a human being, you can't be so ungrateful..." After saying this, Fan Jinhua choked and turned around and went out.ungrateful?This family really knows how to handle her!When Xu Xidi heard this, he was so upset that he got up and walked out of the room, carrying a basket on his back without eating.No matter what, the pigs in the pen still have to be fed today.This year I will find a way to feed one more pig and sell it to save money.After last night, she thought about it.The Zhang family wants a child, right?Then give birth!She will leave after giving birth!Get rid of this home once and for all!...Xu Xidi walked to the end of the village angrily, and happened to see his uncle Liu Ye entering the village carrying two large bales of grass, which were used to feed the cattle."Brother Xi, are you going to cut pigs and vegetables?" Even though he was picking up cattle and grass that were two or three times larger than others, Liu Ye's tone was still relaxed and there was sweat on his face, but it didn't look like he was tired.According to his strength, he could hold a hundred kilograms of stones in one hand and still walk as fast as flying. This bundle of cow grass must not have weighed a hundred kilograms, so the pole jumped on his thick shoulders as if it had jumped back on its own."Uh...Uncle, you've already come back from doing some work. It's quite early." Xu Xidi responded to his greeting as usual."It's not too early today." Liu Ye responded with a smile.After the two of them passed by each other, Xu Xidi carried the bamboo basket and walked far away before he dared to look back.Liu Ye has already entered the village carrying pigweed.Liu Ye is a very poor household in the village. Because of his age, Xu Xidi calls him uncle.He is thirty-five years old and has not yet married a wife.The reason is very simple. He is an orphan, his family is poor, he is stupid, and he eats a lot. He has to eat at least five bowls in one meal.A few years ago, the village brigade divided the land, giving each person one acre of paddy field and two acres of dry land. After growing food, excluding the public grain, the rest was not enough for him to feed himself.But fortunately, he is strong and diligent, so he can easily take care of his little land in a few days.In the remaining free time, he would be called upon by anyone in the village who was too busy. He would not be paid any wages and would have to work for two meals a day, lunch and dinner.He was also having a blast.Zhang Guohai's family always looked for him.Every year during the busy farming season, when plowing the fields and harvesting in autumn, he would finish Zhang Guohai's work as soon as possible before making his own work.Finally, I was busy with other people in the village.In short, everyone loves to call him, especially last year when a group of young people from the village went to Shenzhen City. Many families had fewer laborers, and even fewer had to ask him for help.Xu Xidi looked at the back of the person who was flying away. Could it be him last night?He was so strong that it was like lifting a little chicken.She really couldn't think of a more suitable person besides him. He was silly, obedient, strict-mouthed, and the most reliable.Maybe they could let him do free labor in the future and raise children together... Xu Xidi was not at home, so Zhang Guohai and Fan Jinhua began to sit in the fire room again, chattering and discussing.Zhang Guohai looked angrily, "What does she want to do? Just throw Ah Fu to the ground like that, ungrateful white-eyed wolf! She doesn't regard her husband as a human being at all. How dare you expect her to be obedient after giving birth to a child?" Fan Jinhua also thought the same, but she couldn't add fuel to the fire at this time and had to solve the problem."I think it was Ah Fu who made her angry in the morning. When she has a baby and becomes a mother, she will know how to live a good life." Zhang Guohai couldn't agree, "It's hard to say. Her parents just threw her out. In such a family, it's hard to sayThe children here are all cruel and ruthless."A few days ago, I saw her talking to the Zhao family, and kept asking Zhao Caiyan about going to Shenzhen City. Did she want to sneak out behind our back?""What?"Fan Jinhua was confused when she heard this.She was shocked, "Why is she asking about Zhao Caiyan?" "No, we have to let her and Ah Fu get the marriage certificate. Then she will be tied to our family for the rest of her life." "After getting the certificate, she can't get married even if she runs away, and there are children here, she must have to take care of it.Family ties."The new policy is different. I'm not old enough to get it! I blame you for being too anxious. You should postpone having a child for another two years and wait for two years to get the certificate."Zhang Guohai snorted and blamed the old woman for being too anxious."Can I not be anxious? I've already asked someone to figure it out. We, Ah Fu, are afraid that we won't survive next year and can't wait to get the certificate with her." Fan Jinhua burst into tears when she said this."If Ah Fu dies, under what pretext can we ask her to give birth to a child for our family? What will the villagers say? Even spittle can drown people!" She wiped her tears as she said, "A Fu is still here, so we let her have a child. Otherwise, it is really free for someone to raise a daughter and a wife..." Fan Jinhua said, looking towards the opposite side.Zhang Guohai glanced at his waist and said, "Our Zhang family is about to become extinct in this generation, and it's your fault..." "When my sisters get married, they can give birth to three or four. There are only two in our family, one is mute, and the other can't walk..." What she meant was very clear. Zhang Guohai was a devil of a man, he was not good at breeding, and the children he gave birth to were terrible.And after giving birth to her son, she became a widow.Not only was he unable to do that job, he couldn't even do any heavy work. After the land was divided, the family relied on Liu Ye for help.Zhang Guohai's face darkened, he folded his hands, turned his head and snorted again, "Then is the person you are looking for reliable? Are you sure you can have a son in one go?" "The man said that there is a greater chance of having a son for three days in a row. If you want to be safer, you have to do it for seven days in a row." Fan Jinhua told everything about what he had calculated at the market that day."What? It takes seven days to get insurance?" Zhang Guohai's eyes widened, "Is that person a liar? Is it so complicated to have a child?" After staring, he felt a little guilty.Fan Jinhua rolled her eyes at him, "Seven days can be called complicated? One is a good child, the other is strong, and you can be pregnant in seven days." Zhang Guohai was a little confused. They listened to the sound late into the night last night. It was already frustrating enough, but they have to listen to it for seven days in a row?Don't blame Ah Fu for losing his temper, he almost wanted to lose his temper.It’s about a man’s dignity, who would feel better?"Have you told anyone? Seven days." Zhang Guohai said dullly."Didn't I discuss it with you first?" "We discussed it before, but you didn't mention it for seven days, so you're talking about it now!" "I'm not afraid that you won't agree. Things have started to be done now, and no one can look back. In the past two days, I will stew some meat for Xidi to make up for it, and wrap it up." Fan Jinhua had already made a plan.
